core: constraints as conditions shaping project choices
supporting: project management as organized application of skills and tools
outOfScope: procurement, employment, legal, or organizational advice

claims.claim: A project is a temporary initiative or endeavor with beginning and end dates that creates a product, service, or result.
Temporary refers to the existence of a beginning and end, not to a short duration.
A program coordinates related projects or activities to deliver outcomes and benefits connected to shared objectives.
A portfolio is a managed collection of projects, programs, and related work used to advance organizational objectives; its components need not be interdependent.

Official public-sector guidance characterizes projects as temporary structures with defined activities, objectives, and constraints on funding and resources, and notes that they may be part of programs.
Project-management approaches should be selected in context rather than presented as one-size-fits-all guarantees.
